summary.title: Welcome Visitors
summary.one_liner: The C2 WikiWikiWeb welcome page explains what the original wiki community is, how to navigate it, and where to start as a newcomer.
takeaways: The WikiWikiWeb (C2) has been running since 1995 and focuses on people, projects and patterns in software development.
Wiki content is a work in progress and much of it is subjective; it is a forum for sharing ideas rather than a reference site.
Newcomers can browse via StartingPoints, use FindPage search, or open RandomPages.
Use the WikiWikiSandbox for trial edits and read WelcomeToWikiPleaseBePolite before contributing.
For encyclopedic reference, the page points to Wikipedia instead.
summary.summary: This is the front page of the C2 WikiWikiWeb, a long-running community wiki (since 1995) centered on people, projects and patterns in software development. It explains the culture to newcomers, warns that the content is subjective and always in progress, and asks visitors to keep a polite tone. The page is mainly a navigation hub, linking to starting pages, search, recent changes, the sandbox for editing practice, FAQs for new users, a help desk, and a history of wiki engines. It does not teach a technical topic itself.
